# Battery Cell Performance Characterization - Test Dataset B04

## 1. Operating Specifications and Protocol
This experimental report documents the electrochemical cycling, thermal behavior, and
operational parameters for commercial lithium-ion test cells evaluated under laboratory validation protocols.

According to the deposit README, the current signal adopts a charge-positive polarity convention.
No voltage channel exists in this deposit, so the measured-versus-placeholder distinction does not apply.
Documentation states the charge capacity value is cleared on each new step.
A sampling-rate remark is present for the temperature yet the concrete triggering condition is omitted.

Baseline environmental chamber temperature was maintained at 25.0 C across all test runs.

The README states that the current channel uses the unit mA.

### 1.1 Detailed Instrumentation and Channel Mapping
Galvanostatic cycling was conducted using an automated multi-channel battery test system.

Channel voltages were calibrated against secondary standards prior to dataset acquisition.

Completeness of the current records is verified using exclusively: completeness_counter.
The experiment consists of a single uninterrupted recording; consequently no cycle index segmentation is present and index-recovery methods are not applicable.
Within the dataset the charge/discharge state is determined by: step_type_column.

## 2. Archival Summary and End of Report
Validation dataset B04 concluded without hardware interrupt flags.

---
End of Report B04.
